verification.sha256: Independent SHA-256 recomputation over exact UTF-8 bytes; scorer values asserted by prospective scoring unit tests
verification.lockCommitBinding: Scorer resolves the exact last-touch commit and committer time for this lock file from full Git history; manifest must pin commit SHA, commit time, and lock-file SHA-256.
verification.resultChronology: Every official result fixture must provide timezone-aware retrievedAt and publishedAt. Both must be strictly later than the lock commit; publishedAt must be no later than retrievedAt.

limitations: This lock records code identity only; it does not verify official fixture content or publication metadata authenticity.
If the official source does not provide a verifiable publishedAt, the entire round is ineligible; retrievedAt alone is never a substitute.
Manual fixture, competition, full-time score, and official publication evidence review remains required.
This is not approval to merge, dispatch, or adopt any model change.
